feeds.title: Endangered Species Coalition Blog
feeds.description: Read all the blogs and get updates on the happening world of wildlife. The Endangered Species Coalition's mission is to stop the human-caused extinction of at-risk species, protect and restore their habitats, and guide these fragile populations along the road to recovery.

feeds.title: Speciologie Blog
feeds.description: Speciologie's blog news page provides updates on species preservation and issues. Read about extinct animals, ongoing efforts to revive them, and more. Speciologie is a clothing brand producing premium, cotton-rich clothes featuring 1800s museum-style illustrations of the lost animal species of modern history.

feeds.title: The Guardian » Endangered species
feeds.description: Read about the latest news, updates, and features on endangered species by one of the leading liberal voices in the world! The Guardian, and stay tuned in order to keep up with the pace of the wildlife world! Guardian News & Media (GNM) publishes theguardian.com, one of the world's leading English-language newspaper websites. It is renowned for its agenda-setting journalism.

feeds.title: The Endangered Species Conservation Site
feeds.description: This blog is all about the information on our dear wildlife. The goal of The Endangered Species Conservation Site is to help inform people about the importance of protecting endangered plant and animal species, profile success stories of species recovery, emphasize the critical role of the Endangered Species Act, and highlight the individual actions that we can take.

feeds.title: Wildlife Preservation Canada Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Wildlife Preservation Canada Blog. Read all the news, articles, and blogs about the animals who are on the brink of extinction, and also take a step further to raise funds in order to save the children of nature! Our sole mission is to save animal species at risk of extinction in Canada by providing direct, hands-on care.

feeds.title: Endangered Species Law and Policy
feeds.description: Endangered Species Law & Policy blog focuses on news, events, and policies affecting endangered species issues in California and throughout the United States. Nossaman is a law firm nationally recognized for its endangered species and natural resources practice. The Firm represents public and private entities engaged in a wide range of resource use and conservation activities in the western United States.

feeds.title: Wild Response Blog
feeds.description: Read all our blog posts and get to know more about the world of wildlife and its endangered species and support us in order to fight against the illegal wildlife trade by deploying new techniques and technologies to maximize their impact on the ground. Wild Response is a non-government organization (NGO) and wildlife non-profit. The goal is to prevent endangered species from being pushed into illegal poaching, and extinction, and to support Wildlife Conservation Practitioner's efforts to the fullest extent possible.

feeds.title: Civil & Environmental Consultants, Inc. » Threatened and Endangered Species
feeds.description: Read various blogs and stay updated with all the latest information and news concerning the threatened and endangered species in this segment. Civil & Environmental Consultants, Inc is an engineering and environmental consulting firm with expertise in air quality, civil engineering, ecological sciences, environmental engineering & sciences, and more It provides comprehensive market-oriented consulting services that advance the strategic business objectives of its clients.
